link.title: Managing Scripts Within Bitbybit Cloud Projects
link.description: Scripts are the individual programs inside a Bitbybit project, each written in Rete, Blockly or TypeScript. These pages cover the practical mechanics of working with them: creating a script and choosing its editor, how auto save protects your work, finding scripts again across your projects, importing one from somewhere else, and embedding a finished script in your own website so visitors can run it without a Bitbybit account. Read these alongside the projects pages - the two together are most of what you need to know about the platform itself.
